claims.statement: The PPWR generally applies from 12 August 2026 and sets requirements for packaging placed on the EU market, creating current compliance work around packaging specifications and supplier evidence.
Packaging manufacturers and brands face specification and compliance costs; procurement, quality or packaging leadership is a plausible payer, but exact Polish budgets are unverified.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Packaging, quality or procurement director at a brand or manufacturer
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: A supplier-linked proof vault tied to each packaging SKU and approval event is harder to replace with generic document storage.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own brand subscriptions; brands retain supplier relationships and suppliers retain source documents.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Packaging consultants, laboratories and converters refer brand accounts.

fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Regulatory counsel, security and insurance estimated at 18,000 PLN monthly at scale.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Annual subscription by packaging SKU and supplier count.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: OCR, storage, supplier onboarding and specialist review.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: PLM and packaging software vendors will add PPWR fields; win through lightweight supplier evidence collection and audit exports.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Brand pays for evidence collection before approving or placing a packaging SKU on the market; missing proof causes redesign, delay or compliance cost.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Brand owner, importer or packaging manufacturer
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: New packaging approval, supplier change or PPWR readiness audit.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual subscription and every packaging or supplier revision.

contrary_evidence: Many detailed PPWR measures phase in after 2026, so urgency varies by SKU.
Large brands may extend existing PLM systems.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed brand subscription and supplier data-rights terms are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Offer a customer-uploaded audit pack without supplier integrations and focus on mid-market brands lacking PLM.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Brands and converters own packaging specifications; laboratories and suppliers control supporting evidence.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own brand subscriptions; brands retain supplier relationships and suppliers retain source documents.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No existing rights to brand packaging files or supplier evidence.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control the proof-vault software; customers control evidence access and market decisions.
critical_control_point.subject: Packaging-SKU compliance evidence dataset

economics.acquisition_route: Sell a 10,000 PLN readiness audit, convert spreadsheets and evidence into a vault, then add supplier portals.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 150 brands at 50,000 PLN ARR yields 7.5M PLN ARR; at 22% owner earnings and 4x ARR, a 70% stake exceeds 5M PLN in years 6-9. Incumbent bundling and regulatory urgency are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 20 hours weekly during initial audits; contract packaging specialists.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less supplier onboarding, storage and direct regulatory support; target 80%.
economics.payback: Customer payback through one avoided redesign or weeks of procurement effort; quantify during paid audit.
economics.retention_or_repeat: SKU, supplier and regulation changes keep records active.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned evidence schemas and supplier response benchmarks.
fingerprint.customer: EU mid-market brands, importers and packaging manufacturers.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Brand pays at packaging approval and annual evidence maintenance.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: PPWR readiness review, new SKU or supplier change.

founder_fit: FMCG domain familiarity without using employer resources
risks: Strict separation from all Reckitt confidential resources is mandatory.

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: proposed permissioned sku to evidence record

structure.control_point: Evidence record used at packaging approval

thesis: Build the permissioned SKU-to-proof record that packaging teams consult before approval, starting with paid PPWR readiness audits.
title: PPWR Packaging Proof Vault
